## Simulation
Status: solved. Voltages are measured from BAT1.1 (the first battery's − terminal).
- BAT1: 9.00 V battery, supplying 14.9 mA
  - BAT1.0 (off-board): 9.00 V
  - BAT1.1 (off-board): 0.00 V
- R1: 470 ohm resistor, 14.9 mA
  - R1 pin 0 (b2, lead1): 9.00 V
  - R1 pin 1 (b6, lead2): 2.00 V
- LED1: LED ON (lit), 14.9 mA
  - LED1 pin 0 (c8, cathode): 0.00 V
  - LED1 pin 1 (c6, anode): 2.00 V

## Breadboard topology (always true)
- Columns 1-63. Holes a1-e1 share one node; f1-j1 share another node (center channel divides them).
- Same rule for every column: a-e connected together, f-j connected together.
- To connect top half (a-e) to bottom half (f-j) of the SAME column, you MUST add a wire.
- tp = positive top rail (+), tn = negative top rail (GND).
- bp = positive bottom rail (+), bn = negative bottom rail (−).
- Rails are NOT connected to body rows — you must wire from rail to a body hole explicitly.
- 882 holes total: 63 columns × 14 rows.
